repos_data.description: Invoke is a leading creative engine for Stable Diffusion models, empowering professionals, artists, and enthusiasts to generate and create visual media using the latest AI-driven technologies. The solution offers an industry leading WebUI, and serves as the foundation for multiple commercial products.
:triangular_ruler: Create beautiful generative image patterns from a string in golang.

TouchDesigner MCP server, describe a visual to Claude, Cursor or Codex and it builds a real, playable node network (audio-reactive, generative, particle, 3D, feedback) with live knobs + MIDI/OSC/DMX, then checks for errors and previews its own work.
MCP server that turns AI into an SVG artist
